drift_check:
DRIFT CHECK — WHY THIS IS NECESSARY BUT NOT THE MISSING GROWTH.
Let A0=N_eta(A), V0=N_eta(V). Existing extraction, after bounding N_eta(A D A^-1) by an envelope times A0, has the form
  V0^3 >= L_lower * A0,
where L_lower is small (positive scale powers and inverse envelope costs). The current packing, source transfer, coarsening and localization have the complementary form
  V0^3 <= L_upper * A0
once the actual A^142 envelope is applied, up to a harmless small-cardinality branch; L_upper is large. These inequalities are compatible. They do not become contradictory merely by paying the constants more sharply, and no strict product growth has been proved here.
The remaining substantial ingredient must amplify a scalar/commuting set or otherwise gain a positive scale exponent beyond this cube-root-size balance. In particular, the scalar projection theorem needs a genuine nonconcentrated coefficient family and a comparison at the extracted scalar-set scale. An upper bound on traces relative to A0 is not automatically an upper bound relative to V0. Concentration of A does not automatically transfer to V. Do not repeat the cubic argument in another wrapper and describe it as amplification.
